_meta.about: The gifts a gate boss leaves when it dies. The player takes exactly one of the three; the choice is permanent. `amount` is added to `stat`; `quest_bonus` more if the player solved that boss's quest (src/boons.py decides how that is recognised).
_meta.design: REBALANCE_MASTER_PLAN.md decision D1. Each stat is offered at exactly two gates. Wisdom gifts are smaller: depth already supplies the clock.

asterion_minotaur.title: Three Things Lie Where The Bull-Man Fell
asterion_minotaur.quest_line: The Thread is still warm in your pack, and it adds a little to whatever gift you take.

gifts.name: The Bull's Horn
gifts.text: You break the horn from his head and find it heavier than a sword.

gifts.name: Ariadne's Clew
gifts.text: The thread remembers every turning of the maze.

gifts.name: Daedalus's Design
gifts.text: The plan of the maze is cut upon this wax tablet in the builder's own hand.

medusa_gorgon.title: Three Gifts Wait In The Quiet Temple
medusa_gorgon.quest_line: The Aegis hums upon your arm, and a little more comes with the gift you choose.

gifts.name: Athena's Counsel
gifts.text: The grey-eyed goddess offers you no thanks, but gives you her counsel.

gifts.name: Hermes's Sandals
gifts.text: Perseus left them lying where he had stood.

gifts.name: The Healing Vein
gifts.text: Blood from her right side mends what blood from her left would kill.

fafnir_dragon.title: Three Things Remain In The Dragon's Hollow
fafnir_dragon.quest_line: You met him from below as Sigurd did, and the gift is the greater for it.

gifts.name: Sigurd's Arm
gifts.text: The strength that opened a dragon stays in the shoulder that dealt the blow.

gifts.name: The Dragon's Bath
gifts.text: Skin that is bathed in the dragon's blood turns to horn.

gifts.name: The Roasted Heart
gifts.text: Burn your thumb on it, as Sigurd did, and be wise.

fenrir_wolf.title: Three Things The Wolf Leaves Behind
fenrir_wolf.quest_line: The ribbon held, so you shall have more of whatever gift you take.

gifts.name: The Dwarves' Cunning
gifts.text: The dwarves' ribbon held what no chain could hold.

gifts.name: A Cat's Footfall
gifts.text: It is the first of six things not found in the world.

gifts.name: The Wolf's Nose
gifts.text: With it you smell the snow three rooms away.
